context.body: Bones, descendants, and later memory · Psalms 105:16–23
context.label: Bones, descendants, and later memory

observations.body: Famine, Joseph’s sale, fetters, testing, release, instruction, and Israel’s descent are arranged as remembered preparation.
observations.label: The psalm recalls a man sent ahead through slavery

observations.body: The passage presents Joseph is sent, afflicted, tested, released, and appointed as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Joseph is sent, afflicted, tested, released, and appointed

observations.body: The passage places The LORD calls famine and sends a man ahead beside Joseph is sent, afflicted, tested, released, and appointed.
observations.label: The LORD calls famine and sends a man ahead

payload.posture: Read Psalms 105:16–23 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states famine, Joseph’s sale, fetters, testing, release, instruction, and Israel’s descent are arranged as remembered preparation. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: The psalm recalls a man sent ahead through slavery
